description: This file defines the implementation of the SystemMode plugin for the WPEFramework project. It includes registration, initialization, deinitialization, and lifecycle management of the plugin, along with some logging and system interactions.

classes.name: SystemMode
classes.description: Class implementing the plugin functionality for system mode management, including lifecycle handling within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: SystemMode
methods.description: Constructor for the SystemMode class, initializing internal state and logging startup.

methods.name: ~SystemMode
methods.description: Destructor for the SystemMode class, handling cleanup and logging shutdown.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up system mode interface, and registers callbacks.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters callbacks, releases system mode interface, and releases the service.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Callback invoked when a remote connection is deactivated; submits a job to handle deactivation.
